title: IK+
subtitle: THE AMIGA CLASSIC / GO + EBITENGINE
editorial_notes: Chronological highlights from one uninterrupted audio-enabled tournament, with legal joystick input from the observable-state human pilot.
Retained gameplay keeps the rational PAL rate. No speed changes, forced wins, score edits, restarts or game-state changes are used.
All eight combat fights through round11 are included in full. Waiting/judgement sections and bonus stages are excerpted.
The first bomb bonus fails after21bombs and13kicks. This failure is shown. The second bomb bonus completes all32bombs with20kicks.
The video reaches round13 withBLACK2 and56700points. The full saved input run later ends naturally at round19 withBLACK5 and83500points.
Re-recorded from the same saved legal inputs with stable display publication. Future prepared poses are retained until their display update; scores, outcomes, cuts and English captions are unchanged.
Bonus correction: retain the current shield/fighter picture so restoration for the next preparation cannot clip a reflected ball or flash a future bomb-player pose. Same saved inputs and soundtrack.

cues.text:
The Amiga classic, rebuilt in Go + Ebitengine.
A skilled simulated player takes the white suit.

Follow white: one player, two computer opponents.
Every move uses ordinary joystick controls.

Spacing, timing, and a well-placed counter.
The whole first and second fights are retained.

Two opening bouts. Two first-place finishes.
Next: closing highlights of the first ball bonus.

Left and right, high and low.
Keep the shield in the path of the incoming balls.

All 64 balls deflected.
The tournament continues at green belt.

Watch both opponents before committing.
A strike on one side can leave the other side open.

Round 4 won. White keeps moving.
The full round 5 fight follows.

Another first-place finish.
The next challenge is a field of burning fuses.

Round 6: bomb bonus highlights.
Kick danger away, then make space.

A fragment ends the first bomb bonus.
The tournament continues; the failure is retained.

Later in the same run: purple belt.
Both opponents remain dangerous.

Round 7 won. No restart, no score edits.
Choose the next opening carefully.

Round 8: first place.
Next comes another wave of balls.

Another shield challenge, from both sides.
High, middle, low: keep adjusting.

All 64 balls deflected again.
The brown belt is earned in the same run.

Three fighters. One arena.
The whole round 10 and 11 fights are retained.

Another first-place finish.
White presses on toward black belt.

Eight combat rounds. Eight wins.
Now the closing bomb challenge.

Round 12: final bomb bonus highlights.
This time, white survives the whole stage.

Move, kick, and stay clear of the blast.
The fuse keeps burning after a kick.

All 32 bombs survived, with 20 kicks.
BLACK 2. 56,700 points. Round 13 reached.

A native port, playing the original game data.
Desktop and Android share the same Go simulation.

display_profile: Latched visible pictures in combat, judging, both bonus stages and results; projectile motion remains per update.
